intro.text: In order to sabotage anything, you need to get your hands on it first. In case of Omni-Med Field Surgeons Cloak, it drops off Dyna and mission bosses. It drops in various ql, highest found so far being ql 200. Whole sabotaging business is actually really easy, all you need is Advanced Hacker Tool.

steps.text: If person doing tradeskills have high enough skills, end product can be higher ql as 200. Hacking the cloak also results in losing Omni tag and Biological Metamorphosis buff.
